reviewNotes: Imported from the Open Hymnal Project's ABC score; check the notes and the words against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The score gives no year for the tune; it was in print by 1916, the year of the setting the Open Hymnal copied. The tune ends on D, not on the key note: it may be modal. The Open Hymnal's own source: "Songs of the Cross", 1924 Hymn 208 Lyrics source: "The Choice: in two parts; Part I, containing Psalms and hymns, Part II, containing spiritual songs; designed for public and private worship" (6th ed.)
